title: pull_request_target workflows must key concurrency on the PR number, not run_id
answers: same bot workflow runs 4 or 5 times for one pull request
duplicate pull_request_target workflow runs per PR
why does the PR labeling or size check run again and again
how to dedupe GitHub Actions runs for a pull request
body:
Symptom: The same pull request triggers the same bot workflow four to five times, each run repeating the same work.
Root cause: Workflows in .github/workflows/ used `group: ${{ github.run_id }}`, a unique key per run, so no runs ever coalesce. Under pull_request_target, github.ref resolves to the default branch, so a ref-based key would not identify the PR either.
Fix pattern: Set the workflow-level `concurrency` block to `group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}` with `cancel-in-progress: false`. GitHub then keeps at most one running and one pending run per PR and drops the rest of the queue.
Constraints: Apply only where every event type in the workflow's trigger list runs the same logic. Keep the run-scoped key for workflows whose events do different things, as autoformat-label-notify.yml and copilot-review.yml do.
applies: Workflow-level concurrency blocks in .github/workflows/*.yml that trigger on pull_request_target and only need PR-level deduplication.
says: Automated bots and check workflows run four or five times repeatedly on one pull request.
Pull request size calculations and labeling triggers duplicate multiple times for the same change.
The approval and issue routing bots repeat identical work every time the branch is updated.
Stop duplicate bot runs on pull requests so only pending checks execute without redundant queueing.
Coalesce repeated automated checks so a pull request does not execute multiple identical runs concurrently.
search: Workflows triggered by pull_request_target that perform PR-level deduplication must set the workflow-level concurrency group to ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} with cancel-in-progress set to false. This prevents repeated runs by keeping at most one running and one pending run per PR, replacing run-scoped keys in .github/workflows/approval.yml, .github/workflows/pr-size.yml, and .github/workflows/route-ready-issue-pr.yml. This pattern applies only when every event type in the trigger list executes identical logic, while workflows with event-specific logic like autoformat-label-notify.yml and copilot-review.yml must keep run-scoped keys.
